verdict.rationale: Weaviate's docs describe hybrid search that runs vector and BM25 keyword search in parallel and fuses their scores into one ranking [docs-1, docs-14]. They offer two fusion strategies, relativeScoreFusion and rankedFusion [docs-2]. Community threads discussing the two fusion algorithms and a hybrid retriever confirm the feature exists, though one user found the fusion math unclear [comm-4]. Missing for 10: hands-on independent corroboration of fusion behavior, and documented detail on tuning the vector/keyword weighting.
